Julie Vos Mobile Nav Prototype

Julie Vos · Mobile navigation

Three directions for the mobile menu

Each one is a working prototype. Open the menu, step into a category, try search, then switch to the next direction.

A · Grouped list

One scrolling menu. The four styles sit at the top with chevrons, then Featured, Holiday, Collections and account links follow as labeled groups. Classics and Colors open their own panels. Closest to the J.Crew reference and the lightest lift on the current theme.

  1. Open the menu and scroll the groups
  2. Tap Earrings (or any style) for the sub-level
  3. Tap the search icon in the header

B · Tabbed sections

Shop, Holiday and Silver tabs mirror the desktop menu one to one. Each tab is a run of alternating white and cream bands: Styles, Featured, Classics, Colors, Collections. Closest to the Sézane reference.

  1. Open the menu and switch between the three tabs
  2. Tap Earrings for the sub-level with its banner
  3. Tap the search icon in the header

C · Visual sections

Photography leads. Square tiles for the four styles, promo tiles for Holiday and Silver, then text groups and color swatches. The strongest brand expression, and it depends on keeping category imagery current.

  1. Open the menu and tap a style tile
  2. Try the Gold / Silver chips in the sub-level
  3. Tap the search icon for the visual search screen

A · Grouped list, text only

The client's structure as one list: search first, the four styles with chevrons, New for Holiday and Gift Guide, then a break before Gold, Silver, Sale and Shop All. The whole menu fits on one screen without scrolling.

  1. Open the menu
  2. Tap Earrings for the two groups and the New Arrivals / Sale / Shop All footer
  3. Tap the search bar

B · Sectioned bands, text only

Same structure, sectioned with small headings and alternating white and cream bands: Shop by style, Holiday, Metal & more. Sub-levels get a serif title and two-column groups.

  1. Open the menu
  2. Tap Earrings for the banded sub-level
  3. Tap the search bar

C · Editorial type, text only

Type does the work the photography did. The four styles set large in the serif, the rest in small tracked caps, Gold / Silver / Sale / Shop All as a compact grid. Sub-levels keep the serif title and larger, lighter links.

  1. Open the menu
  2. Tap a style set in the serif
  3. Tap the search bar

Links that lead off the menu are not wired in this prototype; a small note appears when you tap one. The imagery set follows the live site structure with Featured, Classics and Colors restored on mobile; the text-only set follows the structure in the Nav Updates document.
